subject: afrikaans-fal
description: Afrikaans First Additional Language consolidated question bank. CAPS Foundation Phase (Grades 1-3) + Intermediate Phase (Grades 4-6, in build). TUTORING-FIRST model: every skill targets 20+ items; a learner works through the whole set; a wrong answer triggers Ruby reteaching (show memo) and re-queues that item later. Per-skill fields: gate (NONE), complete_when, reteach_on_error, target_item_count, caps_term, sensitive, templates, recovery_strategy, questions[]. SCHEMA per question: ref, question (English instruction), ruby_prompt (English voiceover), audio (Afrikaans for listening items), context (Afrikaans passage / poster text for reading items), image_refs (optional manifest keys for image-match), input_type, options, expected, memo, error_signals, difficulty (1-3). FAL pedagogy: instructions/hints in English (home language), target content in Afrikaans.

AF.G1.KLK.01.title: Herken rymwoorde (identify rhyming words)
AF.G1.KLK.01.description: Hear Afrikaans words and identify which rhyme.
AF.G1.KLK.01.recovery_strategy: Stretch and exaggerate the ending sound. Compare just two words before offering three choices.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'kat'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. Which word ends with the same sound as 'kat'?
questions.memo: 'kat' and 'mat' both end in the -at sound, so they rhyme. 'hond' and 'boom' end in different sounds.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'huis'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word sounds the same at the end as 'huis'?
questions.memo: 'huis' and 'muis' both end in -uis. They rhyme.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'boom'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen for the ending sound. Which word rhymes with 'boom'?
questions.memo: 'boom' and 'room' both end in -oom, so they rhyme.

questions.question: Do 'son' and 'bal' rhyme?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Do these two words rhyme: 'son' and 'bal'?
questions.memo: 'son' ends in -on and 'bal' ends in -al. The endings are different, so they do not rhyme.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'hond'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word ends with the same sound as 'hond'?
questions.memo: 'hond' and 'mond' both end in -ond. They rhyme.

questions.question: Which TWO words rhyme: 'vis', 'mis', 'kat'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to all three, then pick the word that rhymes with 'vis'.
questions.memo: 'vis' and 'mis' both end in -is, so they rhyme. 'kat' ends in -at.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'hand'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word ends with the same sound as 'hand'?
questions.memo: 'hand' and 'sand' both end in -and, so they rhyme.

questions.ruby_prompt: Which word ends with the same sound as 'boek'?

questions.question: Do 'tand' and 'sand' rhyme?

questions.memo: 'tand' and 'sand' both end in -and, so they rhyme.

questions.question: Do 'boom' and 'kat' rhyme?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Do these two words rhyme: 'boom' and 'kat'?

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'roos'?

AF.G1.WRD.01.description: Core Afrikaans colour words. Picture-based; image_refs key to the manifest. Audio + English-meaning choices work until images are supplied.
AF.G1.WRD.01.recovery_strategy: Pair each colour word with a clear colour block. Practise two contrasting colours first.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'black'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means the colour black?
questions.memo: 'swart' means 'black'. 'wit' is white and 'pers' is purple.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'purple'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means the colour purple?
questions.memo: 'pers' means 'purple'. 'bruin' is brown and 'grys' is grey.

questions.question: What colour is 'oranje'?
questions.memo: 'oranje' means 'orange' — it sounds a lot like the English word.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'brown'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means the colour brown?

questions.question: What colour is 'pienk'?
questions.memo: 'pienk' means 'pink' — it sounds like the English word.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'grey'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means the colour grey?

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'green'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means the colour green?

questions.question: Your friend asks for the 'bruin' crayon. Which colour do you give?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'bruin'. Which crayon should you pick?
questions.memo: 'bruin' means 'brown', so you hand over the brown crayon.

AF.G1.LEE.01.title: Herken sigwoorde (recognise sight words)
AF.G1.LEE.01.description: Recognise high-frequency Afrikaans sight words by sight.
AF.G1.LEE.01.recovery_strategy: Show the word and say it together. Compare words that look different before similar ones (hy/sy).

questions.question: Which word is 'die'?
questions.memo: 'die' means 'the'. It is one of the most common Afrikaans words.

questions.question: What does 'en' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: You see the word 'en'. What does it mean?

questions.question: Which word means 'he'?
questions.memo: 'hy' means 'he'. 'sy' means 'she' and looks similar, so read carefully.

questions.question: What does 'kan' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: You see the word 'kan'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'kan' means 'can', as in 'Ek kan spring' (I can jump).

questions.question: What does 'is' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: You see the word 'is'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'is' means 'is', as in 'Die bal is rooi' (The ball is red).

questions.question: What does 'in' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: You see the word 'in'. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'my' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: You see the word 'my'. What does it mean?

questions.question: Which word means 'not'?
questions.memo: 'nie' means 'not'. 'nee' means no and 'nou' means now — they look similar.

questions.question: What does 'met' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: You see the word 'met'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'met' means 'with', as in 'met die bal' (with the ball).

questions.question: What does 'het' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: You see the word 'het'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'het' means 'has/have', as in 'Ek het 'n hond' (I have a dog).

questions.question: What does 'op' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: You see the word 'op'. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'dit' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: You see the word 'dit'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'dit' means 'it', as in 'Dit is warm' (It is warm).

questions.question: You read 'Sy is hier.' Which word tells you it is a girl ('she')?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen and read: 'Sy is hier'. Which word means 'she'?
questions.memo: 'Sy' means 'she', so the sentence is about a girl. 'is' = is, 'hier' = here.

AF.G1.TAA.01.title: Teenwoordige tyd (present tense)
AF.G1.TAA.01.description: Understand and use simple Afrikaans present-tense sentences.
AF.G1.TAA.01.recovery_strategy: Act out the action while saying the sentence. Keep subject (ek/sy) and verb familiar.

questions.question: What does 'Sy hou van skool' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it with me: 'Sy hou van skool'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'Sy' = she, 'hou van' = likes, 'skool' = school. 'She likes school.'

questions.question: Finish the sentence: 'Ek ___ met die bal.' (I play with the ball)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'play'? Ek ___ met die bal.
questions.memo: 'speel' means 'play': 'Ek speel met die bal' (I play with the ball).

questions.question: How do you say 'I run' in Afrikaans?
Finish the sentence: 'Die hond ___.' (The dog sleeps)
What does 'Ons sing' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Ons sing'. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'Hy eet 'n appel' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Hy eet 'n appel'. What does it mean?

questions.question: Finish: 'Sy ___ 'n boek.' (She reads a book)
questions.memo: 'lees' means 'reads': 'Sy lees 'n boek' (She reads a book).

questions.question: How do you say 'We swim' in Afrikaans?
What does 'Hulle dans' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Hulle dans'. What does it mean?

questions.question: 'Ek speel' = I play. How do you say 'She plays'?
questions.ruby_prompt: The verb stays the same. How do you say 'She plays'?
questions.memo: In the present tense the verb does not change: 'Sy speel' = 'She plays'.

questions.question: Finish: 'Ons ___ skool toe.' (We walk to school)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'walk'? Ons ___ skool toe.
questions.memo: 'loop' means 'walk': 'Ons loop skool toe' (We walk to school).

questions.question: What does 'Jy drink water' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Jy drink water'. What does it mean?

questions.question: How do you say 'The dog runs'?
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'The dog runs'?

questions.question: Finish: 'Hy ___ 'n liedjie.' (He sings a song)
questions.memo: 'sing' means 'sings': 'Hy sing 'n liedjie' (He sings a song).

questions.question: What does 'Sy skryf haar naam' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Sy skryf haar naam'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'skryf' = writes. 'Sy skryf haar naam' = 'She writes her name.'

questions.question: Finish: 'Die kat ___ op die mat.' (The cat sits on the mat)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'sits'? Die kat ___ op die mat.
questions.memo: 'sit' means 'sits': 'Die kat sit op die mat' (The cat sits on the mat).

questions.question: What does 'Hulle kyk TV' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Hulle kyk TV'. What does it mean?

questions.question: Ruby says 'Ek lag.' What is happening now?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Ek lag'. What is happening?
questions.memo: Afrikaans present tense covers both 'I laugh' and 'I am laughing': 'Ek lag'.

AF.G1.TAA.02.title: Ontkenning (negation)
AF.G1.TAA.02.description: Understand the Afrikaans double-negative pattern (sentence wrapped with two 'nie').
AF.G1.TAA.02.recovery_strategy: Contrast a positive sentence with its negative. Highlight the two 'nie' words that wrap the idea.

questions.question: What does 'Sy lees nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Sy lees nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'nie' makes it negative: 'Sy lees nie' = 'She does not read'.

questions.question: Does 'Ek hou nie van pere nie' mean the person LIKES pears?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Ek hou nie van pere nie'. Does this person like pears?
options: No, they do not like pears
questions.expected: No, they do not like pears
questions.memo: The two 'nie' words wrap the sentence to make it negative: 'I do NOT like pears.'

questions.question: How do you say 'Do not run' in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which one tells someone NOT to run?
questions.memo: 'Moenie ... nie' means 'Do not ...': 'Moenie hardloop nie' = 'Do not run'.

questions.question: Make it negative: 'Hy speel' → 'He does NOT play'.
questions.ruby_prompt: Which sentence means 'He does not play'?
questions.memo: Add 'nie' at the end: 'Hy speel nie' = 'He does not play'.

questions.question: What does 'Sy kan nie spring nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Sy kan nie spring nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: The two 'nie' words make it negative: 'She cannot jump.'

questions.question: What does 'Hy eet nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Hy eet nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'nie' makes it negative: 'Hy eet nie' = 'He does not eat'.

questions.question: Make it negative: 'Sy sing' → 'She does NOT sing'.
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'She does not sing'?
questions.memo: Add 'nie' at the end: 'Sy sing nie' = 'She does not sing'.

questions.question: Does 'Ek het nie 'n hond nie' mean the person HAS a dog?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Ek het nie 'n hond nie'. Do they have a dog?
options: No, they do not have a dog
questions.expected: No, they do not have a dog
questions.memo: The two 'nie' words wrap the sentence: 'I do NOT have a dog.'

questions.question: How do you say 'Do not touch' in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'Do not touch'?
questions.memo: 'Moenie ... nie' means 'Do not ...': 'Moenie raak nie' = 'Do not touch'.

questions.question: What does 'Hulle speel nie buite nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Hulle speel nie buite nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: The two 'nie' words make it negative: 'They do not play outside.'

questions.question: Does 'Sy is nie moeg nie' mean she IS tired?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Sy is nie moeg nie'. Is she tired?
questions.memo: 'nie ... nie' makes it negative: 'She is NOT tired.'

questions.question: Which word makes an Afrikaans sentence negative?
questions.memo: 'nie' means 'not' — it makes a sentence negative.

questions.question: What does 'Ek wil nie slaap nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Ek wil nie slaap nie'. What does it mean?
options: I do not want to sleep
questions.expected: I do not want to sleep
questions.memo: 'nie ... nie' wraps it: 'I do NOT want to sleep.'

questions.question: How do you say 'Do not run' in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'Do not run'?
questions.memo: A command 'Do not ...' uses 'Moenie ... nie': 'Moenie hardloop nie'.

questions.question: Does 'Hy kan nie swem nie' mean he CAN swim?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Hy kan nie swem nie'. Can he swim?
questions.memo: 'nie ... nie' makes it negative: 'He CANNOT swim.'

questions.question: Make it negative: 'Ons werk' → 'We do NOT work'.
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'We do not work'?
questions.memo: Add 'nie' at the end: 'Ons werk nie' = 'We do not work'.

questions.question: What does 'Die baba huil nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Die baba huil nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'nie' makes it negative: 'The baby does not cry.'

questions.question: How many 'nie' words wrap a long negative like 'Ek hou nie van koffie nie'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Count the 'nie' words in 'Ek hou nie van koffie nie'.
questions.memo: Afrikaans wraps a negative idea with two 'nie' words: one after the verb and one at the end.

questions.question: What does 'Moenie praat nie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Moenie praat nie'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'Moenie ... nie' = 'Do not ...': 'Moenie praat nie' = 'Do not talk'.

questions.question: Choose the correct negative for 'She does not read.'
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you say 'She does not read'?
questions.memo: Put 'nie' after the verb (here at the end): 'Sy lees nie' = 'She does not read'.

AF.G1.LUI.02.title: Verstaan alledaagse frases en groete (understand everyday phrases & greetings)
AF.G1.LUI.02.description: Understand common Afrikaans greetings and classroom phrases.
AF.G1.LUI.02.recovery_strategy: Anchor each phrase to a picture of the situation. Offer the English meaning as a hint before the Afrikaans choices.

questions.question: What does 'Goeie môre' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Goeie môre'. What does it mean?

questions.question: Someone says 'Hoe gaan dit?'. What is a good reply?
questions.ruby_prompt: 'Hoe gaan dit?' means 'How are you?'. What is a good answer?
questions.memo: 'Goed, dankie' means 'Good, thank you' — a good reply to 'How are you?'.

questions.question: What does 'Mag ek asseblief water kry?' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. What is this person asking for?
questions.memo: 'Mag ek asseblief...?' is how you politely ask for something. Here it asks for water.

questions.question: What does 'Totsiens' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Totsiens'. When do you say it?
questions.memo: 'Totsiens' means 'Goodbye' — you say it when you leave.

questions.question: What does 'Goeie middag' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Goeie middag'. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'Goeienag' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Goeienag'. When do you say it?
questions.memo: 'Goeienag' means 'Good night' — you say it at bedtime.

questions.question: What does 'Wat is jou naam?' ask?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Wat is jou naam?'. What is being asked?
questions.memo: 'Wat is jou naam?' means 'What is your name?'.

questions.question: Someone asks 'Wat is jou naam?'. What is a good reply?
questions.ruby_prompt: How do you answer 'Wat is jou naam?'
questions.memo: 'My naam is ...' means 'My name is ...' — the reply to 'What is your name?'.

questions.question: What does 'Mag ek asseblief uitgaan?' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. What is this person asking?
questions.memo: 'Mag ek asseblief...?' politely asks permission. Here it asks to go out.

questions.question: What does 'Sit asseblief' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Sit asseblief'. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'Luister asseblief' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Luister asseblief'. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'Ek is jammer' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Ek is jammer'. What does it mean?

questions.question: Someone asks 'Hoe gaan dit?'. They reply 'Dit gaan goed'. What does the reply mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Dit gaan goed'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'Dit gaan goed' means 'It is going well' — a reply to 'How are you?'.

questions.question: What does 'Tot môre' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Tot môre'. What does it mean?

questions.question: Your teacher says 'Goeie môre, klas'. What is the teacher doing?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Goeie môre, klas'. What is the teacher doing?
questions.memo: 'Goeie môre, klas' = 'Good morning, class' — a greeting.

questions.question: What does 'Dankie, jou ook' mean (after a wish)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'Dankie, jou ook'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'Dankie, jou ook' means 'Thank you, you too'.

AF.G1.LUI.03.title: Beantwoord vrae oor 'n storie (answer questions about a heard story)
AF.G1.LUI.03.description: Listen to a short Afrikaans story and answer who/what/how-many/where questions.
AF.G1.LUI.03.recovery_strategy: Re-read the story one sentence at a time and ask the question right after the matching sentence.

questions.question: Where is the cat?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer: where is the cat?
questions.audio: Die kat sit op die mat.
questions.memo: The story says 'Die kat sit op die mat' — the cat sits on the mat.

questions.question: How many balls does Tom have?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then answer: how many balls?
questions.memo: 'drie' means three. Tom het drie balle = Tom has three balls.

questions.question: Why is the dog eating?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then answer: why does the dog eat?
questions.audio: Die hond is honger. Hy eet kos.
questions.memo: The story says 'Die hond is honger' — the dog is hungry, so he eats.

questions.question: What is Sara playing with?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then answer: what does Sara play with?
questions.memo: 'pop' means doll. Sara speel met haar pop = Sara plays with her doll.

questions.question: Where is the bird?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then answer: where is the bird?
questions.audio: Die voël vlieg in die lug.
questions.memo: 'in die lug' means in the sky/air. The bird flies in the sky.

questions.question: What is the boy playing with?
questions.audio: Die seun speel met die bal.
questions.memo: 'speel met die bal' = plays with the ball.

questions.question: Where does Mom buy bread?
questions.audio: Mamma koop brood by die winkel.

questions.question: Where is the dog?
questions.audio: Die hond hardloop in die tuin.

questions.question: How many eggs are in the basket?
questions.audio: Daar is vyf eiers in die mandjie.
questions.memo: 'vyf' means five. Five eggs in the basket.

questions.question: Where does the cat sleep?
questions.audio: Die kat slaap op die bed.

questions.question: Why is Tom crying?
questions.audio: Tom huil want hy het geval.
questions.memo: 'want hy het geval' = because he fell.

questions.question: Where are the birds?
questions.audio: Die voëls sing in die boom.

questions.question: What colour is the girl's dress?
questions.audio: Die meisie het 'n rooi rok aan.

questions.question: What do they eat for supper?
questions.memo: 'vir aandete' = for supper. They eat pizza.

questions.question: How is the weather?
questions.memo: 'Die son skyn helder' = the sun shines brightly — it is sunny.

AF.G1.WRD.03.title: My klere (clothes)
AF.G1.WRD.03.description: Afrikaans clothing vocabulary. Image-match against the manifest; audio + English-meaning choices until images are supplied.
AF.G1.WRD.03.recovery_strategy: Link each word to a picture of someone wearing the item. Group by where it is worn.

questions.question: What does 'hoed' mean?
questions.memo: 'hoed' means 'hat' — it goes on your head.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'jersey'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means a warm jersey?
questions.memo: 'trui' means 'jersey'. 'jas' is a coat and 'sokkies' are socks.

questions.question: What does 'jas' mean?
questions.memo: 'jas' means 'coat'. You wear it when it is cold.

questions.question: Tap the picture for 'hoed'.
questions.memo: 'hoed' means 'hat'. It goes on your head.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'scarf'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means a scarf?
questions.memo: 'serp' means 'scarf'. You wind it around your neck to stay warm.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'coat'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means a coat?

questions.question: Is this right? A 'hoed' goes on your feet.
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'hoed'. Does it go on your feet?
questions.memo: A 'hoed' (hat) goes on your head, not your feet. 'skoene' (shoes) go on your feet.

questions.question: It is cold and Ma says 'Trek jou trui aan.' What should you put on?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'trui'. What should you put on?
questions.memo: 'trui' means 'jersey', so you put on your warm jersey.

AF.G1.WRD.04.title: Voedsel (food)
AF.G1.WRD.04.description: Afrikaans food vocabulary. Image-match against the manifest; audio + English-meaning choices until images are supplied.
AF.G1.WRD.04.recovery_strategy: Use pictures of single, recognisable foods. Practise fruits as one set first.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'bread'?
questions.memo: 'brood' means 'bread'. 'eier' is egg and 'water' is water.

questions.question: What does 'water' mean?
questions.memo: 'water' means 'water' — the same spelling as English.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'egg'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means an egg?

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'juice'?
questions.memo: 'sap' means 'juice'. 'melk' is milk and 'tee' is tea.

questions.question: You are thirsty. Which of these can you drink: 'melk', 'brood' or 'eier'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which one is a drink?
questions.memo: 'melk' (milk) is a drink. 'brood' (bread) and 'eier' (egg) are foods you eat.

AF.G1.WRD.05.title: Diere (animals)
AF.G1.WRD.05.description: Afrikaans animal vocabulary. Image-match against the manifest; audio + English-meaning choices until images are supplied.
AF.G1.WRD.05.recovery_strategy: Pair each animal word with its picture and, where helpful, its sound. Start with pets/farm animals.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'cow'?

questions.question: What does 'olifant' mean?

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'sheep'?

questions.memo: 'skaap' means 'sheep'. 'koei' is cow and 'vark' is pig.

questions.question: What does 'leeu' mean?

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'pig'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means a pig?

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'snake'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means a snake?

AF.G1.WRD.06.title: Die weer (weather)
AF.G1.WRD.06.description: Afrikaans weather vocabulary. Image-match against the manifest; audio + English-meaning choices until images are supplied.
AF.G1.WRD.06.recovery_strategy: Connect each word to today's weather or a clear picture. Contrast pairs (koud/warm, son/reën).

questions.question: Which word means 'cold': 'koud' or 'warm'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to both. Which one means 'cold'?

questions.question: What does 'wind' mean?
questions.memo: 'wind' means 'wind' — it is the same word in English.

questions.question: Tap the picture for 'sneeu'.
questions.memo: 'sneeu' means 'snow'. It is white and very cold.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'cloud'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means a cloud?

questions.question: What does 'wind' mean?
questions.memo: 'wind' means 'wind' — the same word as in English.

questions.question: It rains while the sun shines and you see a 'reënboog'. What is that?
questions.memo: 'reënboog' means 'rainbow' — the band of colours after rain.

AF.G1.WRD.07.title: Vorms, grootte en rigting (shapes, size, direction)
AF.G1.WRD.07.description: Afrikaans words for shape, size and position. Image-match against the manifest; audio + English-meaning choices until images are supplied.

questions.question: Which word means 'big': 'groot' or 'klein'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to both. Which one means 'big'?

questions.question: Tap the picture where the ball is 'op die boks' (on the box).
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'op'. Which picture shows the ball ON the box?
questions.memo: 'op' means 'on'. The ball is on top of the box.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'circle'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means a round circle?

questions.question: Tap the picture where the ball is 'in die boks' (in the box).
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'in'. Which picture shows the ball IN the box?
questions.memo: 'in' means 'in'. The ball is inside the box.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'square'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means a square?
questions.memo: 'vierkant' means 'square' — it has four equal sides.

questions.question: Which Afrikaans word means 'triangle'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which Afrikaans word means a triangle?

AF.G1.TAA.03.title: Vraagsinne (question words)

questions.question: What does 'Wie?' ask about?

questions.memo: 'Wie?' means 'Who?' — it asks about a person.

questions.ruby_prompt: The question word 'Hoeveel?' — what is it asking about?
questions.memo: 'Hoeveel?' means 'How many?' — it asks about a number.

questions.question: What does 'Hoekom?' mean?
questions.memo: 'Hoekom?' means 'Why?' — it asks for a reason.

questions.question: Finish: 'Ek het twee ___.' (two hands)

questions.question: What does 'gelukkig' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: The describing word 'gelukkig' — what does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'vinnig' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: The how-word 'vinnig' — what does it mean?
questions.memo: 'vinnig' means 'fast'. 'Die hond hardloop vinnig' = 'The dog runs fast'.

questions.question: Finish: 'Die seun is ___.' (The boy is happy)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which describing word means 'happy'? Die seun is ___.
questions.memo: 'gelukkig' means 'happy': 'Die seun is gelukkig' (The boy is happy).

questions.question: Which picture shows 'die groot hond' (the big dog)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'die groot hond'. Tap the right picture.
questions.memo: 'groot' = big. This is the big dog.

questions.question: Which picture shows 'die klein hond' (the small dog)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'die klein hond'. Tap the right picture.
questions.memo: 'klein' = small. This is the small dog.

questions.question: Finish: 'Die kat is ___.' (The cat is small)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'small'? Die kat is ___.
questions.memo: 'klein' means 'small': 'Die kat is klein' (The cat is small).

questions.question: 'Die hond hardloop ___.' Which word means he runs FAST?
questions.memo: 'vinnig' means 'fast/quickly': 'Die hond hardloop vinnig' (The dog runs fast).

questions.question: Finish: 'Die meisie is ___.' (The girl is happy)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'happy'? Die meisie is ___.
questions.memo: 'bly' means 'happy': 'Die meisie is bly' (The girl is happy).

questions.question: 'Praat sag' means 'Talk ___'. Which word?
questions.memo: 'sag' means 'soft/softly': 'Praat sag' = 'Talk softly'. The opposite is 'hard' (loudly).

AF.G2.LUI.01.title: Volg opeenvolgende instruksies (follow consecutive instructions)
AF.G2.LUI.01.description: Respond to two short consecutive Afrikaans instructions.
AF.G2.LUI.01.recovery_strategy: Replay and break into one step at a time. Confirm the first step before the second.

questions.question: What two things were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to both steps, then choose.
questions.audio: Trek 'n sirkel. Kleur dit rooi in.
options: Draw a circle, then colour it red
Draw a square, then colour it blue
Colour a circle, then draw a line
questions.expected: Draw a circle, then colour it red
questions.memo: 'Trek 'n sirkel' = draw a circle; 'Kleur dit rooi in' = colour it red.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.audio: Vat die boek. Sit dit op die tafel.
options: Take the book, put it on the table
Take the pen, put it in the bag
Open the book on the table
questions.expected: Take the book, put it on the table
questions.memo: 'Vat die boek' = take the book; 'Sit dit op die tafel' = put it on the table.

questions.question: Which step comes FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what to do first.
questions.audio: Was jou hande. Eet jou kos.
questions.memo: 'Was jou hande' (wash your hands) is said first, then 'Eet jou kos' (eat your food).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.audio: Staan op. Loop na die deur.
options: Stand up, walk to the door
Sit down, look at the door
questions.expected: Stand up, walk to the door
questions.memo: 'Staan op' = stand up; 'Loop na die deur' = walk to the door.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.audio: Maak die boek oop. Lees die storie.
options: Open the book, read the story
Close the book, draw a picture
Open the door, read the sign
questions.expected: Open the book, read the story
questions.memo: 'Maak die boek oop' = open the book; 'Lees die storie' = read the story.

questions.question: What two things were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Maak die venster toe. Sit op die mat.
options: Close the window, sit on the mat
Open the window, sit on the chair
Close the door, sit on the mat
questions.expected: Close the window, sit on the mat
questions.memo: 'Maak ... toe' = close; 'Sit op die mat' = sit on the mat.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
options: Take your pencil, draw a house
Take your pen, draw a dog
Take your book, read a story
questions.expected: Take your pencil, draw a house

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Tel die bal op. Gooi dit vir my.
options: Pick up the ball, throw it to me
Kick the ball, run to me
Pick up the book, give it to me
questions.expected: Pick up the ball, throw it to me

questions.question: Which step comes FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which do you do first?
questions.audio: Drink jou melk. Borsel jou tande.
questions.memo: The first instruction was 'Drink jou melk' (drink your milk).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Trek jou skoene aan. Loop buite toe.
options: Put on your shoes, walk outside
Take off your shoes, stay inside
Put on your hat, walk outside
questions.expected: Put on your shoes, walk outside

questions.question: Which step comes LAST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which do you do last?
questions.audio: Was jou hande. Droog hulle af.
questions.memo: After washing ('Was jou hande'), the last step is 'Droog hulle af' (dry them).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Maak die deur oop. Roep die hond.
options: Open the door, call the dog
Close the door, feed the dog
Open the window, call the cat
questions.expected: Open the door, call the dog

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Sit die boek in die sak. Gee dit vir Ma.
options: Put the book in the bag, give it to Mom
Take the book out, give it to Dad
Put the pen in the bag, give it to Mom
questions.expected: Put the book in the bag, give it to Mom
questions.memo: 'Sit ... in die sak' = put in the bag, 'Gee dit vir Ma' = give it to Mom.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Staan in 'n ry. Wag vir jou beurt.
options: Stand in a line, wait for your turn
questions.expected: Stand in a line, wait for your turn
questions.memo: 'Staan in 'n ry' = stand in a line, 'Wag vir jou beurt' = wait for your turn.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Kleur die son geel. Kleur die gras groen.
options: Colour the sun yellow, the grass green
Colour the sun red, the grass blue
questions.expected: Colour the sun yellow, the grass green
questions.memo: 'Kleur ... geel' = colour yellow, 'gras groen' = grass green.

questions.question: Which step comes FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which do you do first?
questions.audio: Eet jou kos. Was jou bord.
questions.memo: First 'Eet jou kos' (eat your food), then 'Was jou bord' (wash your plate).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
options: Fold the paper, draw on it

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Pak jou speelgoed weg. Gaan slaap.
options: Pack away your toys, go to sleep
Take out your toys, play more
questions.expected: Pack away your toys, go to sleep
questions.memo: 'Pak ... weg' = pack away, 'Gaan slaap' = go to sleep.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Skryf jou naam. Trek 'n streep daaronder.
options: Write your name, draw a line under it
Write a number, draw a box
questions.expected: Write your name, draw a line under it
questions.memo: 'Skryf jou naam' = write your name, 'Trek 'n streep daaronder' = draw a line under it.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Tel tot drie. Spring dan hoog.
options: Count to three, then jump high
questions.expected: Count to three, then jump high
questions.memo: 'Tel tot drie' = count to three, 'Spring dan hoog' = then jump high.

AF.G2.LUI.02.title: Identifiseer voorwerp uit beskrywing (identify object from description)
AF.G2.LUI.02.description: Listen to a simple Afrikaans description and choose the object it describes.
AF.G2.LUI.02.recovery_strategy: Re-read the description one clue at a time and rule options out clue by clue.

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is rond en rooi. Jy speel daarmee.
questions.memo: Round, red and you play with it = 'n bal (a ball).

questions.question: What animal is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het vier bene. Dit blaf. Dit is 'n troeteldier.
questions.memo: Four legs, it barks (blaf), a pet = 'n hond (a dog).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is geel. Jy eet dit. 'n Aap hou daarvan.
questions.memo: Yellow, you eat it, a monkey likes it = 'n piesang (a banana).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit skyn in die dag. Dit is warm en geel.
questions.memo: Shines in the day, warm and yellow = die son (the sun).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy trek dit aan jou voete. Jy stap daarmee.
questions.memo: You put them on your feet and walk = skoene (shoes).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het vlerke. Dit kan vlieg. Dit sing.
questions.memo: Wings + flies + sings = a bird ('n voël).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is wit. Jy drink dit. Dit kom van 'n koei.
questions.memo: White + you drink it + comes from a cow = milk (melk).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het baie blare. Dit is hoog. Voëls sit daarin.
questions.memo: Many leaves + tall + birds sit in it = a tree ('n boom).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy sit daarop. Dit het vier bene.
questions.memo: You sit on it + four legs = a chair. (A bed has legs too, but you lie on it.)

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is koud en wit. Dit val in die winter.
questions.memo: Cold + white + falls in winter = snow (sneeu).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het vier wiele. Dit ry op die pad.
questions.memo: Four wheels + drives on the road = a car. A bike has two wheels.

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is groen. Dit spring. Dit woon by die water.
questions.memo: Green + jumps + lives by water = a frog ('n padda).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy lees dit. Dit het baie bladsye.
questions.memo: You read it + many pages = a book ('n boek).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit skyn in die nag. Dit is in die lug.
questions.memo: Shines at night + in the sky = the moon (die maan). The sun shines in the day.

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is lank en geel. 'n Aap eet dit.
questions.memo: Long + yellow + a monkey eats it = a banana ('n piesang).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit blaf. Dit het vier bene. Dit is 'n troeteldier.
questions.memo: Barks + four legs + a pet = a dog ('n hond).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy trek dit oor jou kop aan. Dit hou jou warm.
questions.memo: You pull it over your head + keeps you warm = a jersey ('n trui).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is rond. Dit wys die tyd.
questions.memo: Round + shows the time = a clock/watch ('n horlosie).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is rooi en rond. Dit groei op 'n boom. Jy eet dit.
questions.memo: Red + round + grows on a tree + you eat it = an apple. (A ball isn't food.)

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het baie kleure. Jy sien dit ná die reën.
questions.memo: Many colours + after the rain = a rainbow ('n reënboog).

AF.G2.LUI.03.title: Beantwoord vrae oor 'n storie — gebeure in volgorde (story comprehension: events in order)
AF.G2.LUI.03.description: Listen to a short Afrikaans story and answer comprehension and ordering questions.
AF.G2.LUI.03.recovery_strategy: Re-read and pause after each event. Ask 'what happened next?' before the ordering question.

questions.question: What did Tom do FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Tom het opgestaan. Toe het hy ontbyt geëet. Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan.
questions.memo: The story says 'Tom het opgestaan' first — he got up first.

questions.question: What did Tom do LAST?
questions.audio: Tom het opgestaan. Toe het hy ontbyt geëet. Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan.
questions.memo: 'Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan' is the last event — he went to school last.

questions.question: Why was the girl happy?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Lisa het 'n present gekry. Sy was baie bly.
questions.memo: 'Lisa het 'n present gekry' — she got a present, so she was happy (bly).

questions.question: Where did the family go?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die gesin het strand toe gegaan. Hulle het in die see geswem.
questions.memo: 'strand toe gegaan' = went to the beach; they swam in the sea.

questions.question: What did the dog do after it ate?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die hond het kos geëet. Toe het hy gaan slaap.
questions.memo: 'Toe het hy gaan slaap' — after eating, the dog went to sleep.

questions.question: What happened LAST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Ben het 'n bal gevat. Hy het buite gaan speel. Toe het dit gereën.
questions.memo: The last event was 'Toe het dit gereën' (then it rained).

questions.question: What did Mia do FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Mia het kos gemaak. Sy het die tafel gedek. Toe het hulle geëet.

questions.question: Why did Mom comfort the boy?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die seun het geval. Hy het gehuil. Ma het hom getroos.
questions.memo: He fell ('het geval') and cried ('het gehuil'), so Mom comforted him.

questions.question: What did they do AFTER baking the cake?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die gesin het 'n koek gebak. Hulle het kersies opgesit. Toe het hulle gesing.
questions.memo: After baking ('gebak'), they put on candles ('kersies opgesit').

questions.question: Where did Sara go in the end?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Sara het haar tas gepak. Sy het bus toe geloop. Toe het sy skool toe gegaan.
questions.memo: In the end 'sy het skool toe gegaan' (she went to school).

questions.question: What did the dog do with the bone?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die hond het 'n been gekry. Hy het dit begrawe. Toe het hy gaan slaap.

questions.question: How did Tom feel the next day?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Tom was siek. Hy het medisyne gedrink. Die volgende dag was hy beter.
questions.memo: 'die volgende dag was hy beter' = the next day he was better.

questions.question: What washed the castle away?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die kinders het sand gegrawe. Hulle het 'n kasteel gebou. Die see het dit weggespoel.
questions.memo: 'Die see het dit weggespoel' = the sea washed it away.

questions.question: What grew?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Lisa het 'n saad geplant. Sy het dit natgemaak. 'n Blom het gegroei.
questions.memo: 'n Blom het gegroei' = a flower grew.

questions.question: What did the bird do FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die voël het takkies gevat. Sy het 'n nes gebou. Toe het sy eiers gelê.
questions.memo: First 'takkies gevat' (took twigs), then built the nest, then laid eggs.

questions.question: Why did Dad wash the car again?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Pappa het die kar gewas. Dit het vuil geword in die modder. Hy het dit weer gewas.
options: It got dirty in the mud
questions.expected: It got dirty in the mud
questions.memo: 'Dit het vuil geword in die modder' = it got dirty in the mud, so he washed it again.

questions.question: Did the cat catch the mouse?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die kat het 'n muis gesien. Sy het agter hom gehardloop. Die muis het weggekom.
questions.memo: 'Die muis het weggekom' = the mouse got away, so the cat did not catch it.

questions.question: What did they eat?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Ons het na die dieretuin gegaan. Ons het die olifante gesien. Toe het ons roomys geëet.

questions.question: Why did the boy fall?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die seun het sy fiets gery. Hy het te vinnig gery. Hy het geval.
questions.memo: 'Hy het te vinnig gery' = he rode too fast, so he fell.

questions.question: What did they see at the end?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Eers het dit gereën. Toe het die son uitgekom. Toe het ons 'n reënboog gesien.
questions.memo: After the rain and sun, 'ons het 'n reënboog gesien' (we saw a rainbow).

AF.G2.KLK.01.title: Onderskei verwarrende klanke (distinguish confusable sounds)
AF.G2.KLK.01.description: Tell apart Afrikaans sounds that are easily confused.
AF.G2.KLK.01.recovery_strategy: Say the two words back to back, exaggerating the differing vowel. Show the letters.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. Which word was it?
questions.memo: 'mier' (ant) has the 'ie' sound; 'muur' (wall) has the 'uu' sound.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. Which word was it?
questions.memo: 'bal' (ball) has the 'a' sound; 'bel' (bell) has the 'e' sound.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. Which word was it?
questions.memo: 'pen' has the 'e' sound; 'pan' has the 'a' sound.

questions.question: Do 'kat' and 'kot' have the same middle sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to both. Same middle sound?
questions.memo: 'kat' has 'a' in the middle; 'kot' has 'o'. Different sounds.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen carefully. Which word was it?
questions.memo: 'vis' (fish) has the 'i' sound; 'vas' (firm) has the 'a' sound.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.memo: 'muur' (wall) has the 'uu' sound; 'mier' (ant) has the 'ie' sound.

questions.question: Do 'kot' and 'kat' have the same middle sound?
questions.memo: 'kot' has an /o/ and 'kat' has an /a/ — different middle sounds.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.memo: 'bot' has a short /o/; 'boot' (boat) has the long 'oo' sound.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.memo: 'boot' (boat) has the long 'oo' sound; 'bot' is short.

questions.question: Which word did you hear?
questions.memo: 'bas' (bark of a tree) has an /a/; 'bus' has a /u/.

questions.question: Do 'rok' and 'rak' have the same middle sound?
Do 'lam' and 'lem' have the same middle sound?
Which word did you hear?
questions.memo: 'muis' (mouse) has the 'ui' sound; 'muur' (wall) has the 'uu' sound.

AF.G2.KLK.02.title: Letter-klank verhoudings (letter-sound relationships)
AF.G2.KLK.02.description: Match single Afrikaans letters to their sounds.
AF.G2.KLK.02.recovery_strategy: Show the letter, say its sound, give a key word (m -> /m/ -> mat).

questions.question: Which letter makes the /m/ sound?
questions.memo: The letter 'm' makes the /m/ sound, like in 'mat'.

questions.question: Which letter makes the /s/ sound?
questions.memo: The letter 's' makes the /s/ sound, like in 'son'.

questions.question: What sound does the letter 'v' make in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: In Afrikaans, what sound does 'v' make?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans the letter 'v' makes an /f/ sound, like in 'vis' (fish).

questions.question: Which letter makes the /k/ sound?
questions.memo: The letter 'k' makes the /k/ sound, like in 'kat'.

questions.question: Which word starts with the letter that makes /h/?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word starts with the /h/ letter?
questions.memo: 'hond' starts with 'h', which makes the /h/ sound.

questions.question: Which letter makes the /b/ sound?
questions.memo: The letter 'b' makes the /b/ sound, as in 'bal'.

questions.question: Which letter makes the /r/ sound?
questions.memo: 'r' makes a rolled /r/ in Afrikaans, as in 'rok'.

questions.question: Which word STARTS with the /p/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /p/. Which word starts with it?

questions.question: What sound does 'g' make in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to 'goud'. What sound does 'g' make?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans 'g' makes a throaty sound from the back of the mouth, as in 'goud' (gold).

questions.question: Which word STARTS with the /l/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /l/. Which word starts with it?

questions.question: Which letter makes the /f/ sound?
questions.memo: 'f' makes /f/, as in 'fiets'. (The letter 'v' also makes /f/ in Afrikaans.)

questions.question: What sound does 'w' make in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to 'water'. What sound does 'w' make?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans 'w' makes a /v/ sound, so 'water' sounds like 'vater'.

questions.question: Which word STARTS with the /s/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /s/. Which word starts with it?

questions.question: Which word STARTS with the /k/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /k/. Which word starts with it?
questions.memo: 'kat' starts with /k/. In Afrikaans the letter 'k' makes the /k/ sound.

questions.question: What sound does 'j' make in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to 'ja'. What sound does 'j' make?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans 'j' makes a /y/ sound, so 'ja' sounds like 'ya'.

questions.question: Which word STARTS with the /m/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /m/. Which word starts with it?

AF.G2.KLK.03.title: Bou en breek 3-letterwoorde (build & break 3-letter words)
AF.G2.KLK.03.description: Blend and segment simple CVC Afrikaans words.
AF.G2.KLK.03.recovery_strategy: Sound each letter with a finger tap, then sweep to blend. For segmenting, stretch the word.

questions.ruby_prompt: Blend the sounds: k ... a ... t. What word?

questions.ruby_prompt: Blend the sounds: p ... e ... n. What word?

questions.ruby_prompt: Break it up: s-o-n. How many sounds?

questions.question: Put the sounds together: b-u-s
questions.ruby_prompt: Blend the sounds: b ... u ... s. What word?

questions.ruby_prompt: Break it up: m-a-t. What is the first sound?

questions.question: Put the sounds together: s-o-n
questions.ruby_prompt: Blend the sounds: s ... o ... n

questions.question: Put the sounds together: m-a-t
questions.ruby_prompt: Blend the sounds: m ... a ... t

questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'vis'. What is the last sound?

questions.question: Put the sounds together: b-o-s
questions.ruby_prompt: Blend the sounds: b ... o ... s

questions.question: Put the sounds together: l-a-t
questions.ruby_prompt: Blend the sounds: l ... a ... t

questions.question: Which picture matches 'Die meisie ry fiets'?

questions.question: What does 'Die son skyn helder' mean?

questions.question: What does 'Die groot bruin hond slaap' mean?

questions.question: Which picture matches 'Die hond slaap'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then tap the matching picture.

questions.question: What does 'Die seun ry fiets vinnig' mean?

options: The boy rides a bike fast
questions.expected: The boy rides a bike fast

questions.question: Which picture matches 'Die seun ry fiets'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then tap the matching picture.
questions.memo: 'seun' = boy on a bike — not the girl.

questions.question: What does 'Die voël vlieg in die lug' mean?

options: The bird flies in the sky
The bird sits in a tree

questions.question: Which picture matches 'Die meisie loop'?

questions.question: What does 'Die twee honde speel saam' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'Die klein kat slaap op die bed' mean?

options: The small cat sleeps on the bed
The dog sleeps on the bed

questions.question: Which picture matches 'Die hond hardloop' (not the cat)?

AF.G2.LEE.05.title: Beantwoord begripsvrae en som op (comprehension & simple summary)
AF.G2.LEE.05.description: Answer comprehension questions and pick the best one-sentence summary.
AF.G2.LEE.05.recovery_strategy: Re-read, then ask 'what is the whole thing mostly about?' before offering summary choices.

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then pick the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Die hond hardloop. Die hond spring. Die hond speel in die tuin.'
options: A dog playing in the garden
questions.expected: A dog playing in the garden
questions.memo: Every sentence is about the dog playing in the garden (tuin).

questions.question: Read: 'Sara is siek. Sy bly in die bed.' Why does Sara stay in bed?
questions.context: Text: 'Sara is siek. Sy bly in die bed.'
questions.memo: 'Sara is siek' = Sara is sick, so she stays in bed.

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then pick the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Ons eet ontbyt. Ons eet middagete. Ons eet aandete.'
options: The meals we eat in a day
questions.expected: The meals we eat in a day
questions.memo: ontbyt (breakfast), middagete (lunch), aandete (supper) — the meals of the day.

questions.question: Read: 'Die reën val. Die kinders bly binne.' Why do the children stay inside?
questions.context: Text: 'Die reën val. Die kinders bly binne.'
questions.memo: 'Die reën val' = it is raining, so the children stay inside (binne).

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then pick the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Die voël maak 'n nes. Sy lê eiers. Die kuikens kom uit.'
questions.memo: The bird makes a nest, lays eggs, and the chicks (kuikens) hatch — about a bird and her babies.

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read, then choose the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Die kat klim in die boom. Sy kry 'n voël. Sy klim weer af.'
questions.memo: Every sentence is about the cat in the tree.

questions.question: Read: 'Tom hou van sokker. Hy speel elke dag.' What does Tom like?
questions.context: Text: 'Tom hou van sokker. Hy speel elke dag. Hy wil 'n ster word.'
questions.memo: 'Tom hou van sokker' = Tom likes soccer.

questions.question: Read the text. What is the weather like?
questions.context: Text: 'Die reën val hard. Die wind waai. Die weer is sleg.'
questions.memo: Rain + wind + 'die weer is sleg' (the weather is bad).

questions.question: Read: 'Ma koop melk, brood en eiers.' What did Mom buy?
questions.context: Text: 'Ma koop melk, brood en eiers by die winkel.'
questions.memo: The text lists 'melk, brood en eiers'.

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read, then choose the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Die seun plant blomme. Hy gee water. Die tuin is mooi.'
questions.memo: Planting flowers + watering + 'die tuin' (the garden) = making a garden.

questions.question: Read: 'Lisa is jarig. Almal sing vir haar.' Why do they sing?
questions.context: Text: 'Lisa is jarig. Sy kry geskenke. Almal sing vir haar.'
questions.memo: 'jarig' = having a birthday. They sing because it's her birthday.

questions.question: Read: 'Die hond is honger. Hy kry 'n been.' What did the dog find?
questions.context: Text: 'Die hond is honger. Hy soek kos. Hy kry 'n been.'
questions.memo: 'Hy kry 'n been' = he gets/finds a bone.

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read, then choose the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Ons gaan see toe. Ons swem en bou sandkastele. Dit is lekker.'
questions.memo: Going to the sea + swimming + sandcastles = a day at the beach.

questions.question: Read: 'Die voël is moeg. Sy vlieg na haar nes.' Where does the bird go?
questions.context: Text: 'Die voël is moeg. Sy vlieg na haar nes. Sy gaan slaap.'

questions.question: Read: 'Die kar was stukkend. Nou werk dit weer.' What was wrong with the car?
questions.context: Text: 'Pappa maak die kar reg. Dit was stukkend. Nou werk dit weer.'

questions.question: Read: 'Die klas ry met die bus. Hulle besoek die dieretuin.' Where do they go?
questions.context: Text: 'Die klas gaan op 'n uitstappie. Hulle ry met die bus. Hulle besoek die dieretuin.'

questions.question: Read the text. What is it mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read, then choose the best summary.
questions.context: Text: 'Sara help haar ma. Sy was die skottelgoed. Sy vee die vloer.'
questions.memo: Washing dishes + sweeping the floor = helping at home.

questions.question: Read: 'Die seun lees oor ruimteskepe. Hy droom om 'n ruimtevaarder te word.' What does he want to be?
questions.context: Text: 'Die seun lees 'n boek oor ruimteskepe. Hy droom om 'n ruimtevaarder te word.'
questions.memo: 'ruimtevaarder' = astronaut. He dreams of becoming one.

questions.question: Read: 'Dit is winter. Dit is baie koud.' Why do they wear warm clothes?
questions.context: Text: 'Dit is winter. Dit is baie koud. Ons trek warm klere aan.'
questions.memo: Winter + 'baie koud' (very cold) = they wear warm clothes.

questions.question: Read: 'Die muis sien die kaas. Die kat sien die muis.' What might happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read, then predict what comes next.
questions.context: Text: 'Die muis sien die kaas. Hy hardloop vinnig. Die kat sien die muis.'
questions.memo: The cat sees the mouse, so next it will likely chase it. Good readers predict what comes next.

AF.G2.TAA.01.title: Verlede tyd (past tense: het ge-)
AF.G2.TAA.01.description: Understand and form the Afrikaans past tense with 'het' + ge-verb.
AF.G2.TAA.01.recovery_strategy: Contrast 'Ek speel' (now) with 'Ek het gespeel' (done). Point out 'het' + ge-.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the PAST (already happened)?

questions.question: Put 'Ek eet' into the past tense.

questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Put 'Hy lag' into the past tense.

questions.ruby_prompt: Which is the past form? Hulle het TV ___.

AF.G2.TAA.02.title: Tydlyne en volgorde (timelines & sequence)
AF.G2.TAA.02.description: Understand and use Afrikaans sequence words: Eers ... en toe ... Daarna.
AF.G2.TAA.02.recovery_strategy: Lay three events on a line and label them eers/toe/daarna.

questions.question: Which word means 'first' in a sequence?
Finish: 'Eers het ek opgestaan, ___ het ek geëet.' (and then)
questions.memo: 'en toe' means 'and then' — it links the next event.

questions.question: Put the sequence words in order.
questions.ruby_prompt: Order these from first to last.

questions.question: What does 'Eers' mean?
questions.memo: 'Eers' means 'first' — the first thing you do.

questions.question: What does 'Toe' mean in a sequence?
Finish: 'Eers eet ons, ___ borsel ons tande.' (then)
What does 'Uiteindelik' mean?
questions.memo: 'Uiteindelik' means 'finally/at last' — the very last step.

questions.question: Put these sequence words in order.
questions.ruby_prompt: Put them in the right order.

questions.question: In a story, which word usually comes FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word usually starts a sequence?

questions.question: Finish: 'Ons het gespeel. ___ het ons gaan slaap.' (Finally)
Finish: 'Was jou hande ___ jy eet.' (before)
questions.memo: 'voor' means 'before': wash your hands before you eat.

questions.question: 'Eers ... toe ... daarna' help you tell a story in...?
questions.ruby_prompt: What do sequence words help with?
questions.memo: Sequence words ('Eers, toe, daarna') put events in the right order.

questions.question: Put this morning in order.
questions.memo: First get up, then eat breakfast, after that go to school.

questions.question: What does 'voor' mean (in time)?
questions.memo: 'voor' means 'before' in time: 'voor die ete' (before the meal).

questions.question: Which sentence shows the FIRST step?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which one is the first step?
options: Eers maak ek my bed op.
questions.expected: Eers maak ek my bed op.

questions.question: Finish: 'Eers ..., toe ..., en ___ was ek klaar.' (finally)

AF.G2.TAA.03.title: Vraagsinne uitgebrei (expanded questions: Wanneer? Waar?)

questions.question: What does 'Wanneer?' ask about?

questions.memo: 'Wanneer?' means 'When?' — it asks about a time.

questions.question: What does 'Waar?' ask about?

questions.memo: 'Waar?' means 'Where?' — it asks about a place.

questions.question: Which question fits the answer 'By die huis' (At home)?
questions.ruby_prompt: The answer is 'By die huis'. Which question fits?
questions.memo: 'Waar is jy?' (Where are you?) fits a place answer.

questions.question: Which question fits the answer 'Môre' (Tomorrow)?
questions.ruby_prompt: The answer is 'Môre'. Which question fits?
questions.memo: 'Wanneer kom jy?' (When are you coming?) fits a time answer.

questions.question: Which question fits 'In die oggend' (In the morning)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which question fits a time answer?
questions.memo: A time answer ('in the morning') fits 'Wanneer?' (When?).

questions.question: Which question fits 'In die klas' (In the class)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which question fits a place answer?
questions.memo: A place answer ('in the class') fits 'Waar?' (Where?).

questions.question: What does 'Wanneer is jou verjaarsdag?' ask?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it ask?
questions.memo: 'Wanneer?' = When. It asks for a time.

questions.question: What does 'Waar woon jy?' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'Waar?' = Where. 'Waar woon jy?' = Where do you live?

questions.question: Which question word asks about a TIME?
Which question word asks about a PLACE?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word asks about a place?

questions.question: Which question fits 'Vanmiddag' (This afternoon)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which question fits a time answer?

questions.question: Which question fits 'By die see' (At the sea)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which question fits a place answer?

questions.question: What does 'Wanneer kom jy?' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Which question fits 'Onder die bed' (Under the bed)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which question fits a place answer?
questions.memo: A place answer ('under the bed') fits 'Waar?'.

questions.question: Make a question for the answer 'Môre' (Tomorrow).
Make a question for the answer 'In die park'.
questions.memo: 'In die park' is a place, so use 'Waar?'.

questions.question: Your friend answers 'By die skool, vanoggend.' Which TWO questions did you ask?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which two questions does this answer?

AF.G2.TAA.04.title: Voorwerpsvoornaamwoorde (object pronouns: my, hom, haar)
AF.G2.TAA.04.description: Understand and use Afrikaans object pronouns.
AF.G2.TAA.04.recovery_strategy: Show who receives the action (She helps ME). Practise my/hom/haar.

questions.question: What does 'Sy help my' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Sy help my'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'my' here means 'me': 'Sy help my' = 'She helps me'.

questions.question: What does 'Hy roep ons' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Hy roep ons'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'ons' here means 'us': 'Hy roep ons' = 'He calls us'.

questions.question: Finish: 'Die juffrou help ___.' (helps them)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'them'? Die juffrou help ___.
questions.memo: 'hulle' means 'them': 'Die juffrou help hulle' = 'The teacher helps them'.

questions.question: What does 'Ek sien hom' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'Hy roep ons' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'Die hond byt my' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: What is the difference between 'hy' and 'hom'?
questions.memo: 'hy' is the subject (he does the action); 'hom' is the object (the action happens to him).

questions.question: What does 'Sy ken haar' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Finish: 'Die juffrou help ___.' (helps them)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'them'? Die juffrou help ___.

questions.question: What does 'Wys my' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Which is correct: 'Ek sien ___' (I see her)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word fits: I see her?
questions.memo: After the verb you use the object pronoun 'haar' (her), not 'sy' (she).

questions.question: What does 'Ek hou van jou' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'jou' = you (object): 'Ek hou van jou' = 'I like you'.

questions.question: In 'Sy gee dit vir hom', who receives the thing?
questions.memo: 'vir hom' = to/for him. He receives it.

AF.G2.TAA.05.title: Koppelwerkwoord 'is' (linking verb 'is')
AF.G2.TAA.05.description: Understand and use the Afrikaans linking verb 'is'.
AF.G2.TAA.05.recovery_strategy: Join a subject to a describing word with 'is' (Sy + is + bly).

questions.question: Finish: 'Sy ___ gelukkig.' (She is happy)
questions.memo: 'is' links them: 'Sy is gelukkig' = 'She is happy'.

questions.question: What does 'Die hond is groot' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Die hond is groot'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'is' means 'is': 'Die hond is groot' = 'The dog is big'.

questions.question: Finish: 'Ek ___ moeg.' (I am tired)
questions.memo: Afrikaans uses 'is' for 'am/is/are': 'Ek is moeg' = 'I am tired'.

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'is' correctly?
questions.memo: 'Die kat is klein' = 'The cat is small'. 'is' goes after the subject.

questions.question: What does 'Die kos is lekker' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'Die kos is lekker'. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'lekker' = nice/tasty: 'Die kos is lekker' = 'The food is nice'.

questions.question: Finish: 'Die bal ___ rond.' (is round)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word links them? Die bal ___ rond.
questions.memo: 'is' links the thing to its description: 'Die bal is rond' (The ball is round).

questions.question: What does 'Ek is honger' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Finish: 'Die kinders ___ bly.' (are happy)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word links them? Die kinders ___ bly.
questions.memo: 'is' works for one or many: 'Die kinders is bly' (The children are happy).

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'is' correctly?
questions.memo: Order: thing + 'is' + describing word: 'Die son is warm'.

questions.question: What does 'Sy is my maat' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'is' = is: 'Sy is my maat' = 'She is my friend'.

questions.question: Finish: 'Die water ___ koud.' (is cold)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word links them? Die water ___ koud.
questions.memo: 'is' links water to 'koud' (cold): 'Die water is koud'.

questions.question: In 'Die hond is groot', which word is the linking word?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word is the linking word?
questions.memo: 'is' is the linking verb — it joins 'die hond' to 'groot'.

questions.question: What does 'Ons is reg' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Finish: 'Jy ___ slim.' (are clever)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word links them? Jy ___ slim.

questions.question: Which word fits: 'My ma ___ 'n dokter'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word fits: My ma ___ a doctor?
questions.memo: 'is' links 'my ma' to her job: 'My ma is 'n dokter' (My mom is a doctor).

questions.question: What does 'Dit is reg' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?

questions.question: Which word order is correct?
questions.memo: thing + 'is' + describing word: 'Die blom is mooi' (The flower is pretty).

questions.question: Finish: 'Die honde ___ vriendelik.' (are friendly)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word links them? Die honde ___ vriendelik.
questions.memo: 'is' works for many too: 'Die honde is vriendelik'.

questions.question: What does 'Ek is sewe jaar oud' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it. What does it mean?
questions.memo: 'is' = am: 'Ek is sewe jaar oud' = 'I am seven years old'.

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'is' to DESCRIBE something?
questions.memo: 'Die kat is swart' (The cat is black) describes the cat using 'is'. The others show actions.

AF.G2.TAA.06.description: Understand a wider range of Afrikaans describing words and verbs.
AF.G2.TAA.06.recovery_strategy: Match each new word to a clear picture or action. Practise opposites (lank/kort).

questions.question: What does 'lank' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: The describing word 'lank' — what does it mean?

questions.question: What does the verb 'huil' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: The action word 'huil' — what does it mean?

questions.question: What does the verb 'lag' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: The action word 'lag' — what does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'lekker' mean?

questions.memo: 'lekker' means 'nice/tasty' — a very common Afrikaans word.

questions.question: Which picture shows 'die groot hond' (the big dog)?

questions.question: Which picture shows 'die klein hond' (the small dog)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it, then tap the matching picture.

questions.question: What does 'oud' mean?
questions.memo: 'oud' means 'old'. The opposite is 'nuut' (new) for things, or 'jonk' (young) for people.
