AF.G2.TAA.07.title: Meervoude uitgebrei (extended plurals)
AF.G2.TAA.07.description: Form a wider range of Afrikaans plurals, including common irregulars.
AF.G2.TAA.07.recovery_strategy: Group nouns by plural ending. Flag irregulars as 'special words'.

questions.question: What is the plural of 'blom'?
questions.memo: The plural of 'blom' is 'blomme' (double the m, add -e).

questions.question: What is the plural of 'oog'?
questions.ruby_prompt: More than one 'oog' (eye) is...? This is a special word.

questions.question: What is the plural of 'kind'?
questions.ruby_prompt: More than one 'kind' (child) is...? This is a special word.

questions.question: Finish: 'Ek het drie ___.' (three books)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which is the plural of 'boek'? Ek het drie ___.

questions.question: What is the plural of 'mes' (knife)?
questions.memo: The plural of 'mes' is 'messe' — double the s, add -e.

questions.question: What is the plural of 'glas' (glass)?
questions.memo: The plural of 'glas' is 'glase' (add -e, no doubling).

questions.question: Finish: 'Daar is baie ___.' (many flowers)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which is the plural of 'blom'? Daar is baie ___.
questions.memo: The plural of 'blom' is 'blomme' (double m, add -e).

questions.question: What is the plural of 'dag' (day)?
questions.memo: The plural of 'dag' is 'dae' — a special one (the g drops).

questions.question: Finish: 'Sy het twee ___.' (two eyes)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which is the plural of 'oog'? Sy het twee ___.
questions.memo: The plural of 'oog' is 'oë' — a special one to remember.

questions.question: Finish: 'Daar is baie ___.' (many children)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which is the plural of 'kind'? Daar is baie ___.
questions.memo: The plural of 'kind' is 'kinders' — a special one (adds -ers).

questions.question: Finish: 'Ek het twee ___.' (two hands)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which is the plural of 'hand'? Ek het twee ___.

questions.question: What is the plural of 'been' (leg)?
questions.memo: The plural of 'been' is 'bene' (one e drops, add -e).

questions.question: Most plurals add -e or -s. What is the plural of 'boek'?

AF.G3.LUI.01.title: Beantwoord begripsvrae — insluitend Waarom (comprehension incl. why)
AF.G3.LUI.01.description: Listen to an Afrikaans story and answer comprehension questions, including why.
AF.G3.LUI.01.recovery_strategy: Re-read the cause-and-effect sentence. For 'why', point to the part that gives the reason.

questions.question: Why did Sipho take an umbrella?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer why.
questions.audio: Sipho het 'n sambreel gevat, want dit het gereën.
questions.memo: 'want dit het gereën' = because it was raining. 'want' gives the reason.

questions.question: Why was the boy happy?
questions.audio: Die seun was bly, want hy het 'n nuwe fiets gekry.
questions.memo: 'want hy het 'n nuwe fiets gekry' = because he got a new bike.

questions.question: Who helped the old man?
questions.audio: Die ou man het geval. Anna het hom gehelp om op te staan.
questions.memo: 'Anna het hom gehelp' — Anna helped him.

questions.question: Why did the children stay inside?
questions.audio: Die kinders het binne gebly, want dit was baie koud buite.
options: Because it was very cold outside
questions.expected: Because it was very cold outside
questions.memo: 'want dit was baie koud buite' = because it was very cold outside.

questions.question: Why did the dog bark?
questions.audio: Die hond het geblaf, want 'n vreemde man het by die hek gestaan.
options: A stranger was at the gate
questions.expected: A stranger was at the gate
questions.memo: 'want 'n vreemde man het by die hek gestaan' = because a stranger stood at the gate.

questions.question: Why did the girl put on a coat?
questions.audio: Die meisie het 'n jas aangetrek, want dit was koud.
questions.memo: 'want dit was koud' = because it was cold.

questions.question: Why couldn't Ben sleep?
questions.audio: Ben kon nie slaap nie, want die hond het geblaf.
questions.memo: 'want die hond het geblaf' = because the dog barked.

questions.question: Why did the class laugh?
questions.audio: Die klas het gelag, want die storie was snaaks.
questions.memo: 'want die storie was snaaks' = because the story was funny.

questions.question: What did Sara do BEFORE she ate?
questions.audio: Sara het haar hande gewas voor sy geëet het.
questions.memo: 'voor sy geëet het' = before she ate; first she washed her hands.

questions.question: Why is the farmer happy?
questions.audio: Die boer is bly, want dit het gereën op sy plaas.
questions.memo: 'want dit het gereën' = because it rained — good for the farm.

questions.question: Why did Tom walk slowly?
questions.audio: Tom het stadig geloop, want sy been was seer.
questions.memo: 'want sy been was seer' = because his leg was sore.

questions.question: Why did the teacher praise the children?
questions.audio: Die kinders het hard gewerk. Daarom het die juffrou hulle geprys.
questions.memo: 'Daarom' (that's why) — she praised them because they worked hard.

questions.question: Who is the jersey for?
questions.audio: Ouma het 'n trui gebrei vir die nuwe baba.
questions.memo: 'vir die nuwe baba' = for the new baby.

questions.question: Why did the fish swim away?
questions.audio: Die vis het weggeswem, want die kind het te naby gekom.
questions.memo: 'want die kind het te naby gekom' = because the child came too close.

questions.question: Why did Pieter have to go back?
questions.audio: Pieter het sy boek by die huis vergeet. Hy moes dit gaan haal.
options: He forgot his book at home
questions.expected: He forgot his book at home
questions.memo: 'het sy boek vergeet' = forgot his book, so he had to fetch it.

questions.question: Why did everyone clap?
questions.audio: Almal het hande geklap, want die span het gewen.
questions.memo: 'want die span het gewen' = because the team won.

questions.question: Why did the baby cry?
questions.audio: Die baba het gehuil, want sy was honger.
questions.memo: 'want sy was honger' = because she was hungry.

questions.question: When did the man open the umbrella?
questions.audio: Die man het 'n sambreel oopgemaak toe dit begin reën het.
questions.memo: 'toe dit begin reën het' = when it began to rain.

questions.question: Why did the cat sit on the roof?
questions.audio: Die kat het op die warm dak gesit om in die son te lê.
questions.memo: 'om in die son te lê' = to lie in the sun.

questions.question: Why was the friend happy?
questions.audio: Lebo het haar speelgoed gedeel. Daarom was haar maat baie bly.
questions.memo: 'het haar speelgoed gedeel' = shared her toys; 'Daarom' = that's why the friend was happy.

AF.G3.LUI.02.title: Voorspel wat volgende gebeur (predict the next event)
AF.G3.LUI.02.description: Listen to part of an Afrikaans story and predict what happens next.
AF.G3.LUI.02.recovery_strategy: Recap what happened, then ask 'what makes sense next?' Rule out options that do not fit.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then predict what comes next.
questions.audio: Lebo is baie honger. Sy maak vir haar 'n toebroodjie.
questions.memo: She is hungry and made a sandwich, so next she will eat it.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.audio: Dit is donker. Tom klim in sy bed.
questions.memo: It is dark and he climbed into bed, so next he will sleep.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.audio: Die bal rol na die straat toe. Die hond hardloop agterna.
options: The dog runs into the street
questions.expected: The dog runs into the street
questions.memo: The ball rolled to the street and the dog runs after it, so it will go into the street.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.audio: Die wolke word donker. Die wind waai sterk.
questions.memo: Dark clouds and strong wind are clues that it will rain.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.audio: Die juffrou sê: 'Maak julle boeke oop.'
questions.memo: The teacher asked them to open their books, so they will do it.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die seun trek sy swembroek aan. Hy stap na die swembad.
questions.memo: Swimsuit + walking to the pool → he will swim next.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.memo: When the phone rings, someone usually answers it.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die seun blaas die kersies op die koek.
questions.memo: After blowing out the candles, they cut and eat the cake.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Sy maak die yskas oop en haal die melk uit.
questions.memo: Taking milk out of the fridge → she will pour or drink it.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die baba is moeg en vryf haar oë.
questions.memo: Tired + rubbing eyes → she will fall asleep.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die kinders sit hul jasse aan en stap na die deur.
questions.memo: Coats on + walking to the door → they go outside.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Hy gooi sade vir die hoenders.
questions.memo: Throwing seeds for the chickens → they will eat them.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die juffrou deel die toetse uit.
questions.memo: Handing out tests → the children will write.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Dit is baie warm. Die kind kry 'n roomys.
options: The child eats the ice cream
questions.expected: The child eats the ice cream
questions.memo: Hot day + got ice cream → the child eats it.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die hond sien sy bak met kos.
questions.memo: Seeing its food bowl → the dog will eat.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die wedloop gaan begin. Die hardlopers staan reg.
questions.memo: Race about to start + runners ready → they start running.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Sy vat 'n potlood en 'n stuk papier.
questions.memo: Pencil + paper → she will draw or write.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die emmer is amper vol water en die kraan loop nog.
questions.memo: Almost full + tap still running → it will overflow.

questions.question: What might happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Die seun klim hoog in die boom, maar die tak kraak.
questions.memo: A cracking branch is a warning — it might break and he could fall.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what comes next.
questions.audio: Donker wolke pak saam en daar is weerlig.
questions.memo: Dark clouds + lightning → a storm with rain is coming.

AF.G3.LUI.03.title: Luister na niefiksie en som op (non-fiction: answer & summarise)
AF.G3.LUI.03.description: Listen to short Afrikaans non-fiction and answer / summarise.
AF.G3.LUI.03.recovery_strategy: Re-read each fact. Ask 'what is the whole thing about?' before summary choices.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the facts, then pick the best summary.
questions.audio: Olifante is groot diere. Hulle woon in troppe. Hulle eet gras en blare.

questions.question: What do elephants eat?
questions.audio: Olifante is groot diere. Hulle woon in troppe. Hulle eet gras en blare.
questions.memo: 'Hulle eet gras en blare' = they eat grass and leaves.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the facts, then pick the best summary.
questions.audio: Die son gee lig. Die son gee warmte. Plante het die son nodig om te groei.
questions.memo: All the facts are about die son (the sun).

questions.question: Why do plants need the sun?
questions.audio: Die son gee lig. Die son gee warmte. Plante het die son nodig om te groei.
questions.memo: 'om te groei' = in order to grow. Plants need the sun to grow.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the facts, then pick the best summary.
questions.audio: Visse leef in die water. Hulle swem met hul vinne. Hulle asem deur kieue.
questions.memo: All the facts are about visse (fish).

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.audio: Voëls het vlerke. Hulle kan vlieg. Hulle bou neste in bome.

questions.question: Where do birds build nests?
questions.audio: Voëls het vlerke. Hulle kan vlieg. Hulle bou neste in bome.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.audio: Die maan skyn in die nag. Dit gee nie sy eie lig nie. Dit weerkaats die son se lig.
questions.memo: All sentences are about die maan (the moon).

questions.question: Why are bees important?
questions.audio: Bye maak heuning. Hulle help blomme om vrugte te maak. Bye is baie belangrik.
options: They make honey and help flowers
questions.expected: They make honey and help flowers
questions.memo: Bees make honey and help flowers make fruit — that's why they're important.

questions.question: What do plants need?
questions.audio: Plante het water, son en grond nodig. Sonder water sal hulle doodgaan.
questions.memo: 'water, son en grond' = water, sun and soil.

questions.question: Where does the hippo live?
questions.audio: Die seekoei is 'n groot dier. Dit woon in die rivier. Dit eet gras snags.
questions.memo: 'woon in die rivier' = lives in the river.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.audio: Reën kom uit die wolke. Dit vul die riviere en damme. Ons drink van hierdie water.
questions.memo: Rain filling rivers and dams that we drink from = about where our water comes from.

questions.question: How many legs does a spider have?
questions.audio: Spinnekoppe het agt bene. Hulle spin webbe om insekte te vang.

questions.question: What is the sun?
questions.audio: Die son is 'n groot bal van vuur. Dit is baie ver van die aarde af.
questions.memo: ''n groot bal van vuur' = a big ball of fire.

questions.question: What is this mostly about?
questions.audio: Skilpaaie dra hul huise op hul rûe. Hulle loop baie stadig.
questions.memo: Carrying their house + walking slowly = about tortoises (skilpaaie).

questions.question: What do we make from milk?
questions.audio: Melk kom van koeie. Ons maak kaas en botter van melk.
questions.memo: 'kaas en botter van melk' = cheese and butter from milk.

questions.question: What happens in autumn?
questions.audio: Die herfs is wanneer blare verkleur en val. Daarna kom die winter.
questions.memo: In herfs (autumn), leaves change colour and fall.

questions.question: What is a lion called?
questions.audio: Diere wat vleis eet, word roofdiere genoem. 'n Leeu is 'n roofdier.
questions.memo: Animals that eat meat are 'roofdiere' (predators) — a lion is one.

questions.question: What is ice?
questions.audio: Water kan 'n vaste stof, 'n vloeistof of 'n gas wees. Ys is bevrore water.
questions.memo: 'Ys is bevrore water' = ice is frozen water.

questions.question: Why should we brush our teeth?
questions.audio: Ons tande help ons om kos te kou. Daarom moet ons hulle borsel.
options: So they stay healthy to chew food
questions.expected: So they stay healthy to chew food
questions.memo: Teeth help us chew, so we brush them to keep them healthy.

AF.G3.KLK.01.title: Konsonanttweeklanke uitgebrei (extended consonant blends)
AF.G3.KLK.01.description: Recognise more Afrikaans consonant blends at start/end.
AF.G3.KLK.01.recovery_strategy: Say the cluster joined (spr, str) before the rest. Build from the blend outward.

questions.question: Which word starts with the 'spr' blend?
Which word starts with the 'str' blend?
Which word ENDS with the 'rg' blend?
Which word ENDS with the 'ld' blend?
Which word starts with the 'skr' blend?
Which word starts with the 'kn' blend?
questions.memo: 'knie' (knee) starts with the 'kn' blend — both letters are said.

questions.question: Which word starts with the 'tw' blend?
Which word ENDS with the 'nk' blend?
Which word starts with the 'sl' blend?
Which word ENDS with the 'rt' blend?
Which word starts with the 'spr' blend?
questions.memo: 'spring' starts with the 'spr' blend — three letters.

questions.question: Which word ENDS with the 'lf' blend?
Which word starts with the 'str' blend?
Which word ENDS with the 'rg' blend?
Which word starts with the 'skr' blend?
Which word ENDS with the 'ld' blend?
Which word starts with the 'sw' blend?
Which word ENDS with the 'rk' blend?
Which word starts with the 'vl' blend?
Which word ENDS with the 'rs' blend?

AF.G3.KLK.02.title: Diftonge (diphthongs: eeu, aai, ooi, oei)
AF.G3.KLK.02.recovery_strategy: Stretch the glide and link to a key word (oei -> koei). Compare two at a time.

questions.question: Which word means 'cow' and has the 'oei' sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word is the cow word with 'oei'?
questions.memo: All three have a diphthong, but 'koei' means cow.

questions.question: Which sound is in both 'leeu' and 'sneeu'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which sound do they share?

questions.question: Do 'mooi' and 'gooi' have the same end sound?
questions.memo: Both 'mooi' and 'gooi' end in the 'ooi' sound, so they rhyme.

AF.G3.KLK.03.title: Twee-vokaal klanke (two-vowel sounds: ei, eu, ou)
AF.G3.KLK.03.recovery_strategy: Link each sound to a key word (eu -> seun). Contrast with a single vowel.

AF.G3.KLK.04.title: Klanke wat verskil (e-as-i, d-as-t)
AF.G3.KLK.04.description: Recognise where Afrikaans spelling and sound differ.
AF.G3.KLK.04.recovery_strategy: Say the word naturally, then point to the letter that sounds different.

questions.question: In 'water', the last sound (the 'e' in -er) is which?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'water'. The 'e' at the end sounds like...?
questions.memo: The unstressed 'e' at the end of 'water' is a soft 'uh' sound (a schwa), not a strong vowel.

questions.question: The 'd' at the end of 'brood' sounds like which letter?
questions.memo: At the end of a word the 'd' sounds like 't': 'brood' sounds like 'broot'.

questions.question: Which word ends with a 'd' that sounds like 't'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word has a 'd' that sounds like 't' at the end?

questions.question: In 'later', the last sound (the 'e' in -er) is which?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: 'later'. The 'e' at the end sounds like...?
questions.memo: The unstressed 'e' at the end of 'later' is a soft 'uh' sound (a schwa).

questions.question: Does the 'd' in 'hond' sound like 't'?
questions.memo: Word-final 'd' sounds like 't', so 'hond' sounds like 'hont'.

questions.question: The 'd' at the end of 'hand' sounds like which letter?
questions.memo: At the end of a word, 'd' sounds like 't': 'hand' sounds like 'hant'.

questions.question: In 'moeder', the last 'er' is which sound?
questions.memo: The 'er' at the end of 'moeder' (mother) is a soft 'uh' sound.

questions.question: The 'd' at the end of 'goud' sounds like?
Does the 'd' in 'wind' sound like 't'?
questions.memo: Yes — at the end of a word, 'd' sounds like 't': 'wind' sounds like 'wint'.

questions.question: The letter 'v' in 'vis' sounds like which letter?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans 'v' usually sounds like /f/: 'vis' sounds like 'fis'.

questions.question: The 'w' in 'water' sounds like which letter?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans 'w' sounds like /v/: 'water' sounds like 'vater'.

questions.question: Which word ends with a 'd' that sounds like 't'?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which ends with a 'd' said as 't'?

questions.question: In 'tafel', the 'e' near the end is which sound?
questions.memo: The 'e' in 'tafel' is a soft 'uh' sound — 'tafuhl'.

questions.question: What kind of sound does 'g' make in 'goed'?
questions.memo: Afrikaans 'g' is a throaty sound from the back of the mouth.

questions.question: Does the 'd' in 'brood' sound like 't'?
questions.memo: Yes — end 'd' sounds like 't': 'brood' sounds like 'broot'.

questions.question: The 'd' at the end of 'hoed' sounds like?
In 'lekker', the last 'er' is which sound?
questions.memo: The 'er' at the end of 'lekker' is a soft 'uh' sound.

questions.question: The 'y' in 'vyf' sounds like which two-letter sound?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans, 'y' sounds like 'ei': 'vyf' (five) sounds like 'feif'.

questions.question: Does the 'd' in 'sand' sound like 't'?
questions.memo: Yes — end 'd' sounds like 't': 'sand' sounds like 'sant'.

questions.question: The 'v' at the start of 'vinger' sounds like?

AF.G3.KLK.05.description: Blend and segment Afrikaans words with consonant clusters.
AF.G3.KLK.05.recovery_strategy: Keep the cluster together as one unit while blending the rest.

AF.G3.KLK.06.title: Agtervoegsels (suffixes)
AF.G3.KLK.06.description: Recognise and use common Afrikaans suffixes.
AF.G3.KLK.06.recovery_strategy: Show the base word, then add the ending and say what it changes.

questions.question: What does adding -tjie do to 'kat' (katjie)?
questions.memo: -tjie/-jie makes the 'little' (diminutive) form: katjie = little cat.

questions.question: Which ending makes 'more than one'?
questions.memo: -e or -s makes the plural: boek -> boeke, appel -> appels.

questions.question: What is the 'little' form of 'boom' (tree)?
questions.memo: boom -> boompie (little tree); after 'm' the ending is -pie.

questions.question: What does adding -jie do to 'hond' (hondjie)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: hond ... hondjie. What does -jie do?
questions.memo: '-jie' makes a little one: 'hondjie' = little dog/puppy.

questions.question: What does adding -er do to 'groot' (groter)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: groot ... groter. What does -er do?

questions.question: What does adding -ste do to 'klein' (kleinste)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: klein ... kleinste. What does -ste do?

questions.question: What does 'katjie' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: kat ... katjie. What does 'katjie' mean?

questions.question: What does 'vinnigste' mean?

AF.G5.TAL.07.recovery_strategy: Read the sentence aloud — where you naturally pause, a comma probably belongs.

questions.memo: Commas in a list, no Oxford comma in Afrikaans.
